finding: Immediate exact scoring of every admitted row is unnecessary for sound top-k selection. Certified source-distance intervals can supply upper-threshold witnesses and discard evidence; remaining overlapping finalists can be scored exactly. This is established adaptive-precision filtering, with additional distinct-ID, epoch and bounded-memory obligations for this streaming composition.
card: Limitation: E38's1041.875 exact source distances/query projects6.668B wide distances over6.4M query evaluations; reserve feasibility remains unproved.
Assumption attacked: every int8-admitted source row requires immediate wide exact arithmetic, even when its order is already separated by certified intervals.
Mechanism: unchanged int8 screen, binary64 source intervals, monotone kth upper bound over distinct live IDs, exact scoring only for unresolved final candidates.
Prior art: Shewchuk adaptive predicates, CGAL Lazy_exact_nt, and Fagin/Lotem/Naor bound-based top-k; no originality or inherited instance-optimality claim.
Prediction: wide source scores mean<=64 and samplep99<=128; all raw source interval/refinement rows mean<=2048 and samplep99<=8192, without excluding admitted seeds or fallback work.

phase1_abstraction.objective: For one immutable query and live epoch E, return the k smallest pairs (exact squared source-real L2, stable live ID). Exact source bits define truth; a rounded observed distance or seed upper bound is evidence, not truth.

state.epoch: E fixes source bitstrings, live IDs, ID-to-slot bindings, query bits and the metadata provenance. Reusing an ID after replacement/deletion requires a new epoch/generation.
state.record: At most one record per distinct (E,ID), with sound [L,U], evidence stage, source version and optional exact score. Coverage is tracked separately from whether an ID currently serves as an incumbent witness.
state.incumbents: H contains k distinct live IDs with the smallest retained upper endpoints; T=max(U in H). With fewer than k valid distinct witnesses, T is positive infinity and no threshold exclusion is allowed.
state.candidate_state: Retain every visited, nonexcluded possible winner, plus selected upper-only seed witnesses. Dropping an ID as an upper-bound witness is not a claim that its unseen source row is excluded.
state.coverage: A complete fixed-order scan must cover every live row exactly once in the epoch. Every omitted row has a sound exclusion certificate at its own decision threshold; all surviving upper-only seed records must be interval-refined or exactly resolved before output.

invariants: For each retained record,0<=L<=D_E(ID)<=U. Exact records have L=U=D_E(ID).
H has k distinct live IDs when T is finite; therefore the global kth exact distance is<=T.

Updating an ID intersects existing evidence: L becomes max of sound lowers and U becomes min of sound uppers. An empty intersection is a correctness failure, never a reason to discard the row silently.
Within one fixed epoch, additions of witnesses and tightened endpoints make T nonincreasing. All recorded strict exclusions remain valid as T decreases.
No ID is counted twice toward k, even if it occurs as a seed, a later scan admission and an exact finalist.
An epoch/source-version mismatch invalidates the query state before further pruning or output. A previous threshold is not transferred across a delete/reinsert operation.
Resource exhaustion returns a recorded incomplete/failure result for the necessary counter; it never authorizes dropping an unresolved candidate or returning an uncertified top-k.

transition_proofs.rule: Compute the unchanged4096 minhash seed upper bounds, deduplicate IDs, and retain only the k smallest upper-bound witnesses as seed-only candidate records. Other seeds remain ordinary unvisited rows in the full scan.
transition_proofs.proof: Each witness is a real distinct live row with D<=U<=T, so at least k rows have D<=T. Retaining all4096 seeds as mandatory final candidates would add unjustified raw work and is not this mechanism.

transition_proofs.transition: int8 exclusion or source interval admission
transition_proofs.rule: At each unchanged4096-row block boundary, freeze the current T for its admission decision. Exclude only when a sound certificate lower bound exceeds an outward upper representation of T. Evaluate source intervals for every other row; unsupported/unproved certificates cannot exclude.
transition_proofs.proof: For an excluded row x, D(x)>=L(x)>T and k distinct witness distances are<=T. Thus x is outside the exact top-k, including all tie cases. No oracle kth threshold is used.

transition_proofs.rule: Intersect the new source interval with any existing same-ID seed/interval evidence, refresh the k smallest uppers, then remove records only when L>T. Count every actually evaluated source row, including seed IDs.
transition_proofs.proof: Intersection preserves enclosure. New or tighter uppers cannot increase the kth upper order statistic. A member of the current witness set cannot satisfy L>T, because L<=D<=U<=T; consequently safe eviction cannot remove a required witness.

transition_proofs.rule: After complete coverage, process retained source intervals in increasing (L,ID). Score a row exactly when its lower pair cannot yet prove exclusion against the kth exact pair in a separate exact top-k heap. Stop only when every remaining lower pair is strictly worse than that exact kth pair.
transition_proofs.proof: The exact heap supplies k distinct feasible rows. For any remaining y, (D(y),ID_y)>=(L(y),ID_y); if that lower pair is strictly greater than the exact kth pair, y cannot improve the answer. Before k exact rows exist, no such final exclusion is allowed. This conservative version exact-scores at least k rows and may score all overlapping ties.

transition_proofs.rule: The early interval stage uses strict distance exclusion L>T. In finalization, lexicographic exclusion at L=T is allowed only against an exact kth score and a worse stable ID; otherwise overlapping/equal intervals remain candidates for exact resolution.
transition_proofs.proof: An exact equality plus ID ordering is legitimate evidence; approximate equality or a rounded f32 score is not. Distinct IDs sharing identical vectors remain distinct eligible rows. No label/benchmark identifier exception is introduced.

phase1_abstraction.domain: The first counter uses k10, fixed source/query dimensions1..128 and a single epoch with at least k live rows. Invalid k, nonfinite source bits, duplicate live IDs with conflicting source versions, and malformed lengths fail before state mutation. Dimension129 is an explicit exact-fallback boundary, not silently included in the interval proof.

binary64_interval_lemma.operation_sequence: Promote each original finite binary32 source value exactly to binary64; compute RN(x_i-q_i), square with a separate RN multiplication, and sum the nonnegative terms in a fixed RN order. No norm-minus-dot cancellation, float32 arithmetic, FMA contraction, reassociation or extended-precision register retention is assumed.
binary64_interval_lemma.range_argument: A nonzero difference of finite binary32 numbers has magnitude at least2^-149 and at most2^129. Nonzero squared differences are at least2^-298, and for d<=128 the total is bounded by2^265. Thus binary64 subtraction/square/sum cannot overflow or underflow after exact promotion; zero differences are exact zero.
binary64_interval_lemma.relative_bound: With u=2^-53 and m=d+2, each squared term has two factors from the subtraction error and one from multiplication; at most d-1 sum roundings add factors. The standard product lemma yields |computed-D|<=gamma_m*D, gamma_m=m*u/(1-m*u). The initial addition to zero is exact. This is a derivation from the floating-point model, not an empirical epsilon.
binary64_interval_lemma.outward_endpoints: Precompute a binary64 g>=gamma_m with directed rounding or a verified exact-rational construction; pplus>=1+g and0<pminus<=1-g. Return L=max(0,RD(computed/pplus)), U=RU(computed/pminus). With RN operations, one nextafter in the required direction must be justified for every endpoint-producing operation. If computed==0, the range proof gives D==0 and [0,0] is valid.
binary64_interval_lemma.environment: The interval path requires actual binary64 RN evaluation and exact source promotion. Save/establish/restore the relevant native floating environment on success and error, or reject to the integer/Fraction path without using the interval. Checking fegetround alone does not establish DAZ/FTZ state. On x86, DAZ can zero a binary32 subnormal during promotion; on arm64, the corresponding FP control state must also be accounted for. No M4/x86 timing transfer follows.
binary64_interval_lemma.threshold_conversion: T is a binary64/rational upper endpoint, not an exact score. Feeding the binary32 int8 epilogue requires an upward conversion. If T cannot be represented inside the frozen epilogue's supported arithmetic range, use a conservative fallback/no-prune route. Overflow to positive infinity can be a safe mathematical no-prune threshold, but the current B9 ABI does not accept it and must not be bypassed.
binary64_interval_lemma.final_threshold_comparison: Compare a binary64 lower endpoint's exact rational value against the exact kth score without rounding that score to binary64 first. A downward-rounded exact threshold could falsely exclude a winner. Conservative upward conversion is safe for strict distance exclusion but does not by itself justify an equality/ID tie decision; that decision needs an exact cross-format comparison.
binary64_interval_lemma.fallback: All finite binary32 values fit the mathematical binary64 lemma for d<=128, including source subnormals and maximum finite values. Unsupported environment, source shape or native exact-score range still takes a safe explicit fallback. Nonfinite source values are invalid, not near neighbors.

metadata_producer_vs_usability.distinction: NI_FALLBACK from E36's fixed-grid uint128 metadata producer does not prove the resulting int8 certificate is mathematically unusable. A tiny source coordinate can defeat that producer while the final scale/norm/error fields remain normal and usable.
proposed_order: Try the existing proved native metadata producer once per inserted/replaced row.
On producer-range fallback, derive codes, scale, exact reconstruction norm and error radius once from raw-bit Fraction source values, with directed binary32 endpoints.
Classify the resulting metadata against the frozen B9 numeric/code range contract independently of which producer created it.
If enclosure/provenance and numeric usability are proved, allow that row's certificate; otherwise retain it as a mandatory source-interval candidate.
metadata_producer_vs_usability.qualification: The alternate producer needs its own finite parity/enclosure proof and explicit provenance integration before a native serving claim. Neither unconditional exclusion nor unconditional per-query raw fallback is inferred solely from a native producer return code.
counts_required: mathematically valid normal-field certificates from either producer
per-query mandatory source candidates from the last category
metadata_producer_vs_usability.existing_counter_limit: E38 computed most full-base metadata numerically and only a subset through the exact native/Fraction producer. Its necessary count does not establish this classification for every official row. Preserve that distinction in any first H-B10 numerical counter.

finite_transition_falsifier.enumeration: For n=1,2,3: every distance assignment in{0,1,2}^n, each record's interval chosen from[D,D],[max(0,D-1),D+1],[0,D+2], every arrival permutation, and every k=1..n. Counts are9+324+13122. Compare every transition and final ordered ID list to an independent exact Fraction ordering.
additional_fixed_cases: same-ID seed then scan admission cannot supply two witnesses; identical repeated evidence is idempotent
same ID with different source bits in one epoch is rejected atomically
kth intervals overlap although sorted uppers appear decisive; finalization must retain uncertainty
strict lower boundary just below/equal/above T, with ID ordering both better and worse than the exact kth ID
all-zero duplicates and equal nonzero distances across distinct IDs; no arbitrary tie pruning
witness replacement and repeated tightening preserve monotonic T and prior exclusion validity
delete/reinsert or source-generation mismatch invalidates the state before reuse
empty intersections, malformed evidence and NaN/Infinity reject before mutation
k0, k greater than live count, duplicate-ID conflicts and resource-cap boundary minus1/at/plus1 fail or fall back explicitly
finite_transition_falsifier.arithmetic_cases: Raw binary32 signed zeros; smallest/largest subnormals and neighboring minimum normals; values adjacent to1; opposite maximum finite values; exact duplicates; near ties; dimensions1,2,99,100,101,127,128 and129fallback, with0invalid. Check endpoint neighbors and upward threshold conversion against exact bit-decoded Fraction distances. Exercise nondefault rounding/denormal states only through an explicitly supported native environment test; otherwise require and test conservative refusal.
finite_transition_falsifier.acceptance: All13455 abstract cases and every fixed arithmetic/state boundary pass with zero enclosure, witness-distinctness, threshold, exclusion, order, fallback or restoration errors. One run,180second cap; timeout or missing cases is no pass.
finite_transition_falsifier.purpose: This falsifies transition/proof mistakes; finite cases do not replace the general conditional lemmas or prove target-host performance. No implementation of this falsifier is included in this brief.

independent_oracle.source_truth: Decode each uint32 binary32 bit pattern directly: for normals use signed(2^23+fraction)*2^(exponent-150), for subnormals signed(fraction)*2^-149, and map both zeros to rational0. Form squared differences and sums with Fraction/integer arithmetic. Do not build the oracle through float(np.float32), which could share a promotion/environment failure.
independent_oracle.finite_gate: Every source interval and every threshold/discard transition is checked against raw-bit Fraction truth. Abstract transition inputs are exact rational evidence, independent of the interval implementation.
independent_oracle.development_gate: After serving decisions are frozen, independently Fraction-check every source interval row, every exact finalist/fallback and every interval-based discarded row. Replay threshold witnesses against distinct raw source IDs. The oracle must not call the serving interval routine or consume its endpoints as truth.
independent_oracle.global_topk: The unchanged full-source E38-style independent enclosure pass may isolate global oracle candidates only under its separately reviewed range/error proof, with a separately implemented operation path. Resolve its entire potential-topk set with raw-bit Fraction and compare final ordered IDs. Shared numerical constants are not a reason to omit Fraction checks on every serving-refined row or the finite endpoint tests.
independent_oracle.separation: Oracle scores and candidate sets are unavailable to serving. Preserve aggregate-only reporting on these already exposed development sources, log the look, and report serving and audit work separately without claiming a runtime gain by omitting audit cost.

failure_examples: k duplicate seed entries make T falsely small and can prune the true neighbor
rounding a lower interval endpoint upward can lose a boundary winner
using a seed upper bound as an exact final score can reverse two candidates
promoting a source subnormal under DAZ can turn a positive exact distance into zero
comparing rounded sequential f32 distances can invent or remove ties relative to source-real L2
reusing a pre-delete witness gives a threshold with fewer than k live supporting IDs
discarding interval overlaps to satisfy a memory cap makes the result uncertified

phase3_synthesis.fixed_candidate: Keep4096 minhash seeds,4096-row block order, original int8 certificates and data hashes. Replace immediate source-wide scoring with the specified binary64 interval stage and final exact lower-frontier selection; no seed, width, order or threshold sweep.
phase3_synthesis.first_counter: Only after the finite gate passes: one first16-query easy run, then the identical hard transfer only if easy meets every threshold. Retain600second cap including independent audits and65536-row ambiguity/unresolved guard. Every resource/time failure is recorded without truncating candidates.
phase3_synthesis.source_work_counting: Count unique interval-evaluated rows and all repeated source reads separately; exact finalist rescoring is additional work, not a subtraction from raw work. Include admitted seeds, unusable-certificate rows and all fallback distances. Independently report one-time metadata production and audit Fraction work.

primitive_model.other_charged_work: 26.2144B seed roots and seed selection, gamma/endpoint setup, ID deduplication, upper/lower heap updates, exact top-k ordering, metadata generation including Fraction fallback, updates/I/O/harness and allocation. Query loads and cache misses are not inferred from logical byte counts.
primitive_model.prediction_limit: At the64-row gate, wide query-source scores would be over16x fewer than the E38 work extrapolation, but this is a conditional count reduction, not measured speedup or an official-data estimate. No sustainable per-operation rates are supplied.

phase3_synthesis.memory: Store IDs, stage/version and endpoints, not all admitted raw vectors. A conservative64bytes per unresolved native record gives4MiB at65536records/query before heaps/maps; eight simultaneous queries require at least32MiB plus those structures. This replaces/extends the old scratch budget and must be charged against the7.802GB unmeasured plan, not hidden in it. Python object capacity and audit storage must be reported separately. Large equal-distance clusters can hit the guard and reject this necessary count gate without changing exactness requirements.
phase3_synthesis.budget_rule: Retain the preregistered H-B9 scan/other split for current comparisons. A different split can only be proposed before a new measurement with measured or rigorous evidence for the entire reserve; no retrospective gate relaxation is made. R68's total3600seconds and8GiB remain unchanged.
phase3_synthesis.next_authorized_boundary: Deliver this proof plan for root review. The next smallest action is implementing the finite transition/endpoint falsifier, not a new full counter or kernel. No executable command is invented before that source exists.

reuse_and_equivalence.finding: Existing exact_l2 reproduces sequential binary32 subtraction/multiply/add results. Its exactness contract is bit parity with that rounded sequence, not source-real L2; it cannot be used as H-B10's exact finalist oracle.

E38 uses native/Fraction exact scoring immediately for all admitted rows; its source_intervals helper is retrospective oracle machinery. Move neither those oracle scores nor its output candidate set into serving.
Reuse the checked exact source-score path only inside its declared domain and preserve explicit fallback. Native metadata-range failure is distinct from certificate unusability.
Source-real exact ordering and official stored float32 top100 tie instrumentation remain separate. H-B10 does not repair or redefine the official instrument by matching known-wrong labels.
